Heading.RuleExplanation.BullyHeader.V2: Treat others how you want to be treated
Description.BullyDetail: It's against the rules to say mean things to someone or about another person. It’s also against the rules exclude someone because of who they are, where they come from, or what they believe.
Description.BullyImportance: To keep Boible fun and safe for everyone, don’t use words or actions that are intended to harm or bully others. Boible is for everyone, regardless of their background or beliefs.
Heading.RuleExplanation.PIIHeader: Don't share or request personal information
Description.PIIDetail: It's against the rules to share personal information or ask others to share theirs. This includes phone numbers, email addresses, real names, and phyiscal addresses.
Description.PIIImportance: Information shared with a bad actor can be used to harm you. This can lead to bullying, threats, or identity theft.
Description.SpamDetail: Spam involves repetitive, unwanted, or automated messages or posts, and isn't allowed.
Description.SpamImportance: Spamming harms the experience for others and makes it hard to follow conversations.
Description.ExtortionDetail: Threatening or coercing others for money, favors, or to gain something you want isn't allowed.
Description.ExtortionImportance: Extortion and blackmail can be harmful or dangerous as it threatens users' safety and privacy.
Description.ViolentDetail: Violent content that depicts or promotes serious physical harm, graphic violence, or gore isn't allowed.
Description.ViolentImportance: Graphic or extremely violent content can be traumatic or upsetting, especially for younger users.
Description.DatingDetail: Romantic behaviours such as kissing, dating, or sexting aren't allowed. Keep conversations friendly, not flirty.
Description.DatingImportance: Our community includes users under the age of 18. Online dating puts these users at risk.
Description.HarmfulDetail: Content that encourages, instructs, promotes, or praises dangerous activities isn't allowed.
Description.HarmfulImportance: Encouraging or providing instructions for dangerous activities can cause real-world harm.
Heading.SexualHeaderTop: Keep it appropriate for all ages
Description.SexualDetail: Highly suggestive or sexual content isn't allowed. This includes profile pictures and usernames.
Description.SexualImportance: Sexual content isn't appropriate for all audiences and can harm users or make them uncomfortable, especially younger users.
Description.ImpersonationDetail: Pretending to be someone else or misrepresenting your identity isn't allowed. This also includes impersonating Boible staff members or administrators.
Description.ImpersonationImportance: Impersonation can be used to mislead or confuse others, and may harm the reputation of the person being impersonated.
Description.MisusingSystemsDetail: Misusing our reporting tools or attempting to bypass our safety and security systems breaks our rules and isn't allowed.
Description.MisusingSystemsImportance: Our systems are in place to keep our platform and users safe and secure. Bypassing or misusing these sytems can compromise the safety and integrity of our platform.
Description.UndisclosedAdsDetail: Posting ads or promotional content without disclosure or without using our advertisement systems isn't allowed.
Description.UndisclosedAdsImportance: Honesty and transparency about advertisements and proper use helps maintain trust within the Boible community.
Heading.MisinformationHeaderTop.V2: Be careful with what you share
Description.MisinformationDetail: Spreading false or misleading information that can cause harm to users or communities isn't allowed on Boible.
Description.MisinformationImportance: Spereading misleading information can be harmful to users and communities, especially regarding serious or sensitive topics.
Description.PoliticalDetail: Any content that directly or indirectly promotes, mentions, or otherwise discusses political figures or entities isn't allowed.
Description.PoliticalImportance: To ensure a safe and neutral platform for all users, we don't allow content that discusses or promotes political figures or entities.
Heading.RuleExplanation.SensitiveEventsH: Don't take advantage of sensitive events
Description.SensitiveEventsDetail: Taking advantage of or exploiting real-world sensitive events for personal gain or attention is not allowed.
Description.SensitiveEventsImportance: Exploiting sensitive events can cause harm or distress to those affected and is disrespectful to anyone involved.
Description.ScammingDetail: Attempting to scam or deceive users for personal gain through any means isn't allowed. This includes phishing links or fake offers.
Description.ScammingImportance: Scamming and deception can cause loss of items and money or identity theft, which can harm users and damage trust within the community.
Heading.DisruptiveAudioHeaderTop: Use your voice to contribute, not disrupt
Description.DisruptiveAudioDetail: Audio content that's disruptive, overly loud, or harmful isn't allowed. This includes screaming and loud or annoying noises.
Description.DisruptiveAudioImportance: Disruptive or loud audio can be painful or startling, and can disrupt or ruin the experience for others.
Description.ChargebackDetail: Submitting multiple refund requests or making chargebacks without a valid reason is not allowed. This includes disputing legitimate transactions through your bank.
Description.ChargebackImportance: Unfair chargebacks and refund abuse create financial problems and prevent us from providing a quality service to all users.
Description.IllegalContentDetail: The promotion, sale, or discussion of illegal items, controlled substances, or regulated goods is prohibited on our platform.
Description.IllegalContentImportance: Discussion of illegal or regulated goods or services puts our users at risk and threatens the safety of our community, especially those under 18.
Description.IPViolationDetail: Uploading content that you don't own the rights to, including copyrighted music, videos, and art, isn't allowed without permission from the creator.
Description.IPViolationImportance: Protecting other users' intellectual property rights ensures that creators are fairly credited for their hard work.
